name: io.github.dayfile/dayfile
title: dayfile
description: Append-only log for your scripts and agents: read events, add them, close to-dos.

environmentVariables.name: DAYFILE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the log's API, such as https://USERNAME.dayfile.cloud or your own server.

environmentVariables.name: DAYFILE_READ_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A read token for the log. Needed for reading events.

environmentVariables.name: DAYFILE_WRITE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A write token for the log. Leave it out for a read-only assistant.
